meta.description: The lookup table for project colours — static reference data, not built from any event. 'colour' is the stable name used everywhere else in the model (commands, events, other read models); 'hex' is only ever resolved here, at the point something actually needs to paint pixels. 'order' is the fixed cycle position (1–6) that 'Next colour' advances through and wraps at.
